name: The Garage
tradition: The Power Chord now opens every Rockers home game: lake-effect lights sweep the stage decks, a hometown guitarist hits the thirty-second solo, and the Dawg Pound Pit howls until kickoff shakes the amps.

cue.label: The Power Chord
cue.pregameLine: The stage lights are sweeping The Garage, and the hometown guitarist is already bending the opening solo into the lake wind.
cue.crowdResponse: The Dawg Pound Pit answers with a TURN! IT! UP! chant that rattles every amp on the sideline.
